evidence.observation: Tube pressure drifting monotonically upward during growth: 3.00 → 3.23 Torr from t=2760 to t=3240 while Ar flow and T are at setpoint
Flow steady at ~100 sccm, so rise is not a flow change
Thermocouple holding 750 °C with stable heater power ~44%
Sensor not installed; atmosphere/air-ingress cannot be verified

args.missing_evidence: Exhaust O2 (not installed) to distinguish air in-leak from exhaust restriction; a pump-down/isolation test or Ar-off pressure decay test would discriminate seal leak vs exhaust blockage
